A storm-wracked sky over jagged snow-capped peaks, lightning forking between black thunderheads, rain slashing sideways, distant valleys lost in grey haze far below.
A golden sunset above an endless sea of cloud, the sun a molten disc on the horizon, peaks breaking through the cloud-floor like islands, warm light gilding everything.
Above a besieged castle wreathed in smoke and fire, siege-engines and tiny armies on the plains below, banners burning, a far mountain range hazed in the distance.
Through a deep canyon of thundering waterfalls, mist rising in great white columns, mossy cliff-faces rushing past at speed, the canyon floor a dark ribbon of river far below.
Above an endless ancient forest at dawn, mist pooling between the canopy and valley floors, first light catching the treetops gold, a horizon of unbroken green fading into pale sky.
Over a frozen tundra of glaciers and ice-fields, blue crevasses splitting white plains below, a low arctic sun casting long purple shadows, distant ice-mountains glittering like cut glass.
Among floating sky-islands trailing waterfalls into open air, green meadows and ruins perched on their undersides, clouds threading between them, a vast open sky dropping away in every direction.
Above a vast army massed on a battlefield, formations of infantry and cavalry spreading across the plain like moving rivers, smoke from cook-fires rising, a grey dawn sky overhead.
Over a stormy sea of crashing black waves and half-submerged shipwrecks, rain sheeting across the water, lightning reflected in broken hulls below, a smothered horizon of churning cloud.
Through volcanic ash-clouds above a chain of erupting mountains, red lava-glow pulsing beneath the smoke, ash stinging the air, distant peaks silhouetted in shades of sulphurous orange and black.
Above the crumbling ruins of an ancient city swallowed by jungle, stone towers draped in vines, plazas lost beneath green canopy, a wide river cutting through the overgrowth below.
Over rolling green hills toward a distant citadel on a high promontory, its towers catching pale morning light, farmland patchwork below, a river winding toward it through low mist.
Through a twilight sky above a coral desert of red sandstone arches and mesas, deep shadow pooling in the canyons, a violet sky bleeding into darkness at the zenith overhead.
Above a vast frozen lake reflecting a curtain of green and violet aurora, ice cracked into geometric plates below, pine forests ringing the shore, stars brilliant through the cold clear air.
Over a luminous swamp at midnight, foxfire floating among the cypress roots below, dark water reflecting cold moonlight, vast webs of Spanish moss trailing like curtains in the heavy air.
Through a sky of layered monsoon clouds above a flooded river delta, silver water spreading across lowlands below, rain falling in grey walls, a break in the clouds spilling white light.
Above an ocean trench-coast where black cliffs plunge directly into white surf, sea-stacks rising from the foam below, a high overcast sky silvering the water, storm-birds wheeling in updrafts.
Over a high alpine meadow above the treeline, wildflowers a blur of colour far below, a cirque of pale granite walls curving around, the air impossibly thin and clear and cold.

Through the canopy-level of a bioluminescent night-forest, blue and gold spores drifting upward, enormous dark tree-trunks vanishing below into blackness, a narrow strip of star-filled sky visible far above.
Above a massive coastal city in siege-flame, harbour full of burning ships, streets lit orange below, black smoke climbing in towers into a red-stained night sky over the sea.
Over a sky-spanning bridge of ancient stone arching between two mountain peaks, tiny pilgrims moving across it below, cloud pouring through the gap beneath the arch, eagles circling in the void.

Through a crystal ice-cave system breaking open into open arctic sky, frozen stalactites flashing below, the ice walls fracturing into blue and white light, a blizzard howling across the glacial plain ahead.
Above a sacred valley of tiered temple-pyramids at high noon, priests tiny as ants on the stair-steps below, jungle pressing in from all sides, heat-haze shimmering above the white stone.
Over a dying star-desert at dusk, salt flats glowing pale pink below, dust-devils twisting in the hot air, a band of deep indigo rising in the east as the west burns copper.

Through a rift in the sky above a shattered magical battlefield, reality torn in purple and gold, floating debris of broken earth and stone drifting in open air, the ground scarred and smouldering far below.
